\RequirePackage{pdfmanagement}
\documentclass[14pt,t]{beamer}
\usetheme{Boadilla}
\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}
\setbeamercolor{block title alerted}{fg=white,bg=red!75!black}
\setbeamercolor{block body alerted}{fg=black,bg=red!10!white}
\setbeamercolor{author in head/foot}{fg=white,bg=blue!40!black}
\setbeamercolor{title in head/foot}{fg=white,bg=blue!30!black}
\setbeamercolor{date in head/foot}{fg=white,bg=blue!20!black}
\setbeamercolor{alerted text}{fg=red!60!black}
\begin{document}
\begin{frame}{Accessible Colors Test}
\begin{alertblock}{Notice}
High-contrast alert information.
\end{alertblock}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
